subject: DataBridge Pro pipeline stalled - PIPELINE_STALLED error every night
body: Our nightly DataBridge Pro ingestion pipeline has thrown PIPELINE_STALLED: no heartbeat for 15 minutes on the last 4 nights in a row. Warehouse inventory counts are now out of sync with our ERP and our ops team is manually reconciling every morning. This is affecting live shipments. Please escalate.

subject: Considering switching platforms if this keeps happening
body: This is the third pipeline outage this month. Our VP is now asking why we're paying Enterprise pricing for a tool that can't keep our inventory numbers correct. We are actively looking at competitor options unless this is fixed permanently, not just patched.

subject: How do I map a new IDP group in SecureVault SSO?

subject: WorkflowEngine automation stopped triggering, might have auto-paused
body: Our reorder automation in WorkflowEngine hasn't triggered in 2 weeks. No errors shown anywhere obvious. We haven't changed any config on our end. Wondering if this got auto-paused after failures and nobody told us - this is costing us manual work every day.

subject: Might not renew - budget review in Q4
body: Just a heads up, finance is reviewing all software spend this quarter and WorkflowEngine is on the list given our team hasn't been using it much. Wanted support to know in case usage drops further.

subject: Report exports keep truncating at 1000 rows in AnalyticsHub

subject: CloudSync files not updating, job shows ERR_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT

subject: Requesting call with engineering leadership
body: This is the fourth CloudSync sync issue in two months. Our IT director wants a direct call with your engineering leadership to understand the root cause, not another ticket update. Please arrange this urgently.
